newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas centred on near months at firmer prices.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas centred on near months at firmer prices.

text.p: The IPE natural gas futures contract saw 155 lots traded on Wednesday, with nearly all trade done in June and July.

Front month June saw 95 lots traded, with a further 55 lots done in July. Prices were up, with June last trading up 0.135 pence a therm at 10.65 pence, while July was up 0.085 pence to trade at 10.60 pence shortly before the close.
The remaining five lots were done in a single trade in May 1998 at 11.20 pence a therm. This was the first deal on the May contract, which opened on Wednesday morning.
A spokeswoman for the IPE said that following the expiry of the May 1997 contract on Tuesday, 110 lots representing 110,000 therms a day have gone to physical delivery.
A futures broker said that the IPE contract had been thin on Wednesday but that he was not aware of any specific events which had driven the market or caused it to focus on the summer.
